summary.intent: Resolve automated PR review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then improve the CI/CD pipeline by fixing the release gate to block on E2E tests and consolidating change detection into a single orchestrator workflow.
summary.outcome: All review comments on PR #392 resolved with 3 fixes committed. PR #394 merged to main introducing ci-e2e.yml orchestrator with unified path-based change detection for both web and desktop E2E, plus a retrigger mechanism ensuring release-please PRs re-evaluate after any push to main. PR #396 opened to increase web-e2e timeout from 15→20 minutes and rename e2e.yml to web-e2e.yml.

repo: Release gate (release-gate.yml) only enforced E2E for release-please branches, auto-passing with 'Not a release PR' for all other PRs — this was the root cause of the stale gate issue
web-e2e runs on push to main (not on PRs); desktop-e2e previously had its own dorny/paths-filter; both now delegated to ci-e2e.yml orchestrator
CodeRabbit has a quota/rate-limit that enforces cooldown periods between reviews on the same PR
Committed fixture files live in tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/ — test-audio.mp3, test-document.pdf, test-video-small.mp4, test-video.mp4
Playwright config uses reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI, meaning in CI Playwright starts its own API and web dev servers from scratch
The project uses dorny/paths-filter for conditional job execution and requires fetch-depth: 0 for proper before/after SHA diff
gh run rerun preserves the original GITHUB_SHA, so retrigger jobs must diff against origin/main rather than HEAD
Desktop E2E relevant paths: apps/desktop/**, crates/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, tests/vectors/**, .github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml
Web E2E relevant paths: apps/web/**, apps/api/**, packages/crypto/**, packages/core/**, packages/api-client/**, packages/sdk/**, packages/sdk-core/**, tests/web-e2e/**
Reusable workflow job names in GitHub Actions compose as 'caller-job / callee-job' when checking required status checks

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, and createTestBinaryFile all lacked a guard preventing overwriting committed fixture files — added COMMITTED_FIXTURES set check
Missing faro_enabled: true metadata field that was required by the verification schema
page.evaluate() called in teardown without checking page.isClosed() first, causing errors when page was already closed
dorny/paths-filter requires fetch-depth: 0 to access the before SHA for proper diff; also needs guard for all-zero SHA on branch creation events
Release gate polling loop (40 attempts * 30s = 20 min) must match or exceed the E2E job timeout to avoid declaring failure before E2E completes

workflow: When using gh run rerun to retrigger workflows, the rerun preserves the original checkout SHA — diff comparisons must use origin/main explicitly
dorny/paths-filter with base/ref SHA comparison is more reliable than relying on GITHUB_SHA for detecting relevant changes
Automated reviewer comments that are 'outside diff range' don't appear as GraphQL reviewThreads and must be fetched via the review body instead
gh api GraphQL resolveReviewThread requires the thread node ID, not the comment REST ID — these are different identifiers
Replying to review comments requires the REST comment ID (integer) as in_reply_to, not the GraphQL node ID
Release gate required checks that auto-pass (skip) for non-target PRs provide false security — any required check that can green without actual verification is a gap

friction: CodeRabbit was rate-limited for ~23 minutes mid-session, requiring extensive background polling (~30 minutes of wait loops) before the review arrived
Background poll tasks accumulated during the wait — many completed stale after CodeRabbit eventually posted
Reply attempts to review comment threads via gh api sometimes hit network timeouts and required retries

Initial diagnosis of the release gate issue was wrong twice — first thought it was about feature PRs needing E2E on PRs, then about re-triggering on push, before identifying the real issue: stale green checks on release-please PRs after test: commits land
Outside-diff-range CodeRabbit comments don't surface via GraphQL reviewThreads query, requiring a separate review body fetch to discover them
ci-e2e.yml desktop patterns in release-gate.yml drifted immediately after ci-e2e.yml was written, requiring a fix commit
open_items: Web E2E tests regularly exceeding 20-minute timeout — root cause not yet investigated; Playwright starts API and web dev servers from scratch in CI which adds significant overhead

PR #396 (timeout increase + rename) not yet merged at end of session
The retrigger-release-gate mechanism only re-runs the release gate if a release-please PR is open — if the gate job is already queued or running, gh run rerun behavior is undefined
Release gate polling timeout (40 * 30s = 20 min) is exactly equal to the E2E timeout with no buffer — any overhead in the gate job itself could still cause false failures
